page.overview:
What is Muchi Muchi no Mi?

The Muchi Muchi no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to use whips to command anything they hit, turning the user into a . It was eaten by Kujaku.

This fruit allows the user to implant obedience into whatever the user lashes with a whip.

The effects of the whipping can affect even inanimate, immobile objects, such as buildings. For example, if the user orders an object to move, it will do so regardless of whether it is physically possible or not. It is unknown if the taming effects are temporary or not.

There are no known weaknesses for this fruit besides the usual Devil Fruit weaknesses.
